title: BirdsBirdBirds
tagline: Draw a bird and watch it fly across the sky.
learning_objectives: describing a task so an agent can do it
checking an agent's work with a script

steps.title: Draw your bird
steps.hint: Draw a bird on the page and press Save.
steps.done_when: The file bird.png exists in the workspace.

steps.title: Give it a flight
steps.hint: Tell Pi how your bird should fly.
steps.done_when: bird.json exists in the workspace and passes check-bird.mjs.

steps.title: Watch it fly
steps.hint: Watch your bird cross the sky and tell Pi how it looks.
steps.done_when: The participant watched the bird fly and said so.
